verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at port coverage. A shop page for the 'Nitrokey 3A NFC' (nk3an) points to a USB-A model, and a community user reports ordering and receiving a 'Nitrokey 3C NFC', which points to a USB-C model. The earlier complaint about waiting for Type-C appears to be superseded. Nothing in the pack documents keychain or low-profile nano form factors. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of USB-C vs USB-A connector variants, any evidence of nano/low-profile models, any evidence of keychain form factors, a lineup/form-factor comparison page

support.subject: As a power user, the lineup covers my ports and carry style — USB-C and USB-A models, keychain and low-profile nano form factors

citations.quote: I ordered a Nitrokey 3C NFC 2 years ago, never heard from them until a week ago where they said they shipped it.
The Nitrokey 3 combines the features of previous Nitrokey models
